question: What do the wise call this immersion grounded in supreme will?
premises: The preceding method is grounded in a portion of supreme will-power.
It functions as a true means of realization.
Those of good understanding recognize it as a distinct immersion.
inference: Therefore the wise know this method as the Shambhava immersion.
uncertainties: sumatyantenivāsinaḥ is an unusual compound; the sense 'those dwelling in good understanding' is inferred.
plain_english: Thus those of good understanding know this true means, grounded in a portion of the supreme power of will, as the immersion called Shambhava.
